shortDescription: Membership registration and search landing screen.
fullDescription: Main membership management view with a branded top bar, two large action cards for starting a new membership or reviewing pending processes, a centered search form for locating existing member profiles by personal details or membership number, a results table with status indicators and action links, and a muted call to proceed with a new membership. The view composes the shared application header plus button, card, input, separator, badge, and table primitives and uses the global semantic token layer for its light visual theme.

shortDescription: Reusable branded application header with location and language controls.
fullDescription: Shared top navigation header with the PriceSmart brand mark, contextual location text, country and language selectors, and a secondary blue accent bar. The component accepts configurable location, country, and language labels so multiple views can reuse the same shell without duplicating header markup.

Profile photo capture view for verification workflows with a page heading, camera source selector, centered capture preview area, a guidance card listing photo requirements, and footer actions for returning home, cancelling, taking a photo, and confirming the selected image. The screen reuses the shared application header together with button, card, select, and separator primitives styled through the global semantic token layer.
